topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct; POL-05 acknowledged at hire and yearly in English and Spanish; sanctions applied equally (POL-01 4.8)
evidence: Code of conduct; acknowledgment report 2026 (96% of office users); sanctions log

control_description: Board audit committee receives quarterly cyber risk and POA&M reports from the vCISO, including Grower Services
gap: Quarterly reporting began 2026-09; one meeting on record
remediation: Hold and minute each quarterly report through the observation period

control_description: Security lead, OT owners, and the Grower Services system owner designated; reporting lines in POL-01
Hiring and background checks for settlement analysts; vendor competence through the development contract
evidence: Job descriptions; background check records; training records
gap: No role-based security training for settlement analysts or the development firm's staff; the funded second GRC analyst is not yet hired
remediation: Role-based training (POAM-004); hire the second GRC analyst

control_description: Control owners named in the SSP; directors' objectives include security actions from the POA&M
Grower Services data flows documented in the SSP; settlement inputs from graders, packing lines, and the ERP
gap: No data inventory; grader output not reconciled to packed cases, so input quality is not demonstrated
remediation: Data inventory (POL-04 4.4); weekly grade-to-case reconciliation (POAM-023)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies and standards on the intranet; security briefings to settlement analysts and agronomists
gap: Grower Services staff not briefed on the 2026 policies; standards not yet issued
remediation: Briefing on POL-01 to POL-05 and STD-11; issue standards on schedule

control_description: Marketing agreements state service commitments (99.5% monthly alert availability in season; weekly settlement dates); grower notices of changes and incidents
evidence: Marketing agreement service schedule; grower notices 2026
gap: No security contact or vulnerability disclosure page for the portal; incident notice terms not in all agreements
remediation: Disclosure page (P03 G-046); notice terms at renewal

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Service objectives defined: alert availability, settlement timeliness, settlement accuracy, and confidentiality of grower data
evidence: Marketing agreements; P05 BP-11 and BP-12

control_description: Annual SP 800-30 risk assessment covering Grower Services (P01 R-008, R-010 to R-012, R-031, R-045)
Fraud risks considered: diverted settlement payments and manipulated grades
gap: Bank detail changes accepted by email; call-back and 48-hour hold not yet in force
remediation: Call-back verification and portal bank-change hold (POL-02 4.14; R-010)

control_description: Significant changes (new growers, new grader software, acquisitions) assessed by the Security Manager
gap: Grader software updates and new grower onboarding are not risk-assessed
remediation: Add Grower Services changes to the change meeting agenda; acquisition checklist (R-049)

control_description: Annual independent control assessment by the co-sourced internal audit firm (P07); annual portal penetration test
Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M and reported to the COO monthly and the audit committee quarterly
evidence: P07 poam.csv (24 items); audit committee minutes

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected in the SSP to address the risks in P01, including Grower Services
General IT controls over the Grower Services account: guardrails, identity, backups, logging
gap: Configuration and secure development standards in draft
remediation: Issue STD-01 and STD-11 (POAM-006, POAM-017)

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Policies effective 2026-10-01 (POL-01 to POL-05); procedures under the standards
gap: Most standards in draft; procedures for settlement operations not written
remediation: Issue standards; written settlement run procedure

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Staff console behind the identity provider with MFA; grower accounts with email verification; WAF; company-managed keys
evidence: Identity provider policy; WAF configuration; key service settings
gap: Grower MFA optional (31% enrolled); privileged access management not yet extended to all administrators
remediation: Required grower MFA for settlement and bank functions; PAM for all administrators (POAM-002)

control_description: Staff provisioned from the HR system; grower users registered by Grower Services after a signed marketing agreement
gap: Grower identity verified by email only; no review of grower user lists
remediation: Verify new grower users by call-back; quarterly grower user list review with each grower

control_description: Role-based access in the staff console (grower, agronomist, settlement analyst, administrator)
gap: Annual, not quarterly, access reviews; standing administrator rights; developer production access
remediation: Quarterly reviews (POAM-001); just-in-time administration (POAM-002); remove developer production access (POAM-017)

control_description: Physical security of the cloud provider's data centers (carved out, inherited) and of headquarters offices (badges)
Disposal of grower data and devices
gap: No wipe certificates for returned devices; no deletion process for departed growers' data
remediation: Disposal rules in POL-04 4.9; grower data deletion procedure (POAM-022)

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: WAF and rate limits on the portal sign-in page; cloud firewall; DDoS protection from the provider
gap: Developers reach the Grower Services account from personal laptops
remediation: Managed devices or virtual desktops for developers (R-045)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS 1.2 or higher for the portal and APIs; bank payment files sent over an encrypted channel with keys rotated every 90 days
evidence: TLS scan; secrets manager rotation log

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on company endpoints; container image scanning by the cloud provider
gap: Developer laptops unmanaged; no dependency scanning
remediation: Dependency scanning in the pipeline (POAM-017); managed developer devices

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Quarterly authenticated scans; annual penetration test; cloud posture service
gap: Scans quarterly, not monthly; no dependency or static analysis
remediation: Monthly scans (POAM-019); pipeline scanning (POAM-017)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: SIEM receives portal, identity, cloud, and firewall logs; MSSP monitors 24x7
gap: Settlement change logs not reviewed; no egress volume alerts
remediation: Weekly settlement change review (POAM-005); egress alerts (POAM-020)

control_description: MSSP triages events and escalates within 30 minutes; Security Manager evaluates
gap: No criteria for settlement or grower-data events in the MSSP runbook
remediation: Give P08 severity criteria to the MSSP

control_description: P08 ransomware runbook covers the portal and settlement continuity, grower notices, and counsel
gap: Runbooks approved 2026-09-15 but not exercised
remediation: Tabletop 2026-11-10 including Grower Services (POAM-014)

control_description: Recovery from backups in the separate backup account; spreadsheet settlement by the Controller as fallback
gap: Portal and settlement database restore never tested; no documented restore runbook
remediation: Restore runbook from the development firm; portal restore test (POAM-011)

control_description: Changes deployed through the pipeline by the development firm
gap: No company approval gate; no regression tests; 10 settlement logic changes without company review
remediation: Approval gate, scanning, regression tests, STD-11 (POAM-017)

control_description: BIA objectives for BP-11 and BP-12; cyber insurance; manual settlement fallback
gap: Contingency plan does not yet cover Grower Services
remediation: Contingency plan with Grower Services (POAM-009)

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Vendor reviews for the cloud provider and identity provider; development firm under contract
gap: Development firm has no security or secure development terms and no assurance report; 10 of 14 Tier 1 vendors not reviewed
remediation: Secure development terms and annual attestation; complete Tier 1 reviews (POAM-016)

control_description: Portal and settlement service scale with demand; capacity reviewed before each season
Daily write-once backups to a separate account in a second region (35 days); point-in-time recovery for the settlement database (7 days); provider facilities inherited
evidence: Backup reports July 2026; P07 CP-9 restore test; cloud provider SOC 2

control_description: Recovery plan testing
gap: No recovery test of the portal or settlement service
remediation: Portal restore test into the recovery network (POAM-011)

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: Grower prices, yields, grades, and bank details classified Confidential or Restricted (POL-04); encrypted at rest and in transit; access by role
evidence: POL-04; key service settings; role matrix
gap: Data inventory not built; grower data copied to staff mailboxes as exports
remediation: Data inventory; delete exports after 90 days (POL-04 4.5)

control_description: Retention of 7 years for grower settlement records; deletion on request after the retention period
gap: No deletion procedure for departed growers or for exports
remediation: Deletion procedure and quarterly export purge (POAM-022)

control_description: Pool settlement method and grade standards described in the marketing agreements and grower guide
gap: The settlement calculation used in code is not specified in a document growers or auditors can check
remediation: Settlement specification approved by the Controller and shared with the growers' association (7 CFR 46.32(b))

control_description: Inputs: receiving tickets by grower lot; optical grader output; packing line counts; ERP sales prices
evidence: Receiving tickets; grader reports; P04 control map (SI-10)
gap: Grader output is not reconciled to packed cases; no hand-grade audit; grader software updates not controlled
remediation: Weekly reconciliation and hand-grade audit sample per grower (POAM-023)

control_description: Weekly pool settlement calculation in the settlement service
gap: Logic changes not independently reviewed; no regression tests against prior weeks
remediation: Approval gate and regression tests (POAM-017); Controller sign-off of each run

control_description: Settlement statements reviewed by a settlement analyst before posting; ACH release needs a second approver in finance
evidence: Statement review checklist; bank approval log
gap: Controller review of each run not documented; no exception report for unusual grower results
remediation: Documented Controller review and exception report before release (POAM-023)

control_description: Inputs and outputs stored in the settlement database and backups; 7-year retention
gap: Restore of settlement data never tested; receiving and grader source data kept only 90 days on packing line controllers
remediation: Copy source data to the farm data hub; restore test (POAM-011, POAM-022)
